name: write-user-stories
title_zh: 已批 PRD 到手就拆成排好序
tagline_zh: PRD 批完到开写之间那段最乱的活：拆故事、排依赖、给每条需求留回链。每张卡自带验收标准和具体测试规格。
tagline_en: The messy gap between an approved PRD and writing code: sequenced stories, dependencies, and a traceable link.
desc_en: Turn an approved PRD into sequenced, implementation-ready UI and backend stories with acceptance criteria, concrete test specifications, dependencies, and requirement traceability. Use after write-prd and before story-loop.
why_zh: 不是列个故事清单就完事：它强制每条需求都能追到具体测试规格，缺依赖或漏验收标准的故事卡直接不放行。
why_en: Not just a story list: every requirement must trace to a concrete test spec, and cards missing dependencies or acceptance.
limit_zh: 前置必须有一份已批准的 PRD，没有它直接停住；只产出故事卡和测试规格，不写实现代码、不跑测试；需求变更后要重跑。
limit_en: Requires an approved PRD or it stops; outputs story cards and test specs only, no implementation code or test runs; rerun after requirement changes.
title_en: Approved PRD in, sequenced story cards out—with acceptance.
